name: octobot
description: Octobot: drivable procedural robot octopus in a 3D seabed world (Three.js)

scripts.build:site: npm run build && rm -rf site && mkdir -p site/dist && cp index.html style.css site/ && cp -R public site/ && cp -R root/. site/ && cp dist/app.js site/dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build:site && npx wrangler@4 deploy
